page.overview:
Who is Bart Cumberdale?

When the Simpsons bought a pool, Bart Simpson invited hundreds of children over to swim. Among them was Bart Cumberdale, whom some of the other guests apparently thought was the host, as they addressed him as "Bart". One guest then greeted Marge with "Hello, Mrs. Cumberdale".
